snippet.title: Watch_Dogs -- Season Pass trailer [UK]
snippet.description:
Visit the Official Website: http://watchdogsgame.com 
Join us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/watchdogsgame 
Preorder: http://shop.ubi.com/promo/94715300 

Discover the content of Watch_Dogs' Season Pass: An astonishing single player campaign featuring T-Bone as new playable character, additional missions, skins and weapons and a new mind bending game mode! Buy the Season Pass and get a 25% discount and one week of exclusivity on each additional content.
